capability.summary: Surface sample browser preview failures in the UI so a failed fetch/decode is observable to the user (not just logged to console).

controls.description: When fetchAndDecode rejects for a preview click, the preview button surfaces an error state (class + title) and the previewing highlight is cleared.
controls.test: Mock fetch to return non-audio content; click preview; assert preview button has error class and descriptive title, and no AudioBufferSourceNode is started.
